mapper.select: SELECT id FROM w16_consent_guard WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO w16_match_ticket(id, actor_id, pool, eligibility_version, expires_at, state, match_id) VALUES(#{id}, #{actor}, #{pool}, #{eligibilityVersion}, #{expiresAt}, #{state}, #{matchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE w16_match_ticket SET state=#{state}, match_id=#{matchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id=#{id} AND actor_id=#{actor} AND pool=#{pool} AND eligibility_version=#{eligibilityVersion} AND expires_at=#{expiresAt}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO w16_rendezvous_match(id, first_ticket, second_ticket, public_place, expires_at, version, first_accepted_at, second_accepted_at, state) VALUES(#{id}, #{firstTicket}, #{secondTicket}, #{publicPlace}, #{expiresAt}, #{version}, #{firstAcceptedAt,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{secondAcceptedAt,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{state})
mapper.select: SELECT match_id FROM w16_match_reservation WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM w16_match_reservation WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId} AND match_id=#{matchId}
